question: Should OpenClaw core accept default-off agent self-elected continuation with trusted cross-session delegate returns and the new `agents.defaults.continuation` operator surface?
rationale: The code is coherent and proof-backed, but automation cannot choose the product/security boundary for model-controlled future turns, cross-session context injection, and broad operator knobs.

options.title: Approve after targeted cleanup
options.body: Accept the default-off core feature after the empty status row is fixed and the trusted-return/config/state boundary is recorded as an intentional maintainer decision.

options.title: Narrow the first merge
options.body: Land only self-session continuation and defer cross-session targeting or some knobs until a smaller follow-up has separate security and upgrade review.

options.title: Pause or split
options.body: Keep this PR open but ask for smaller owner-reviewed PRs across tools, TaskFlow, status, Codex, and docs before merging any part.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeted cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept the default-off core feature after the empty status row is fixed and the trusted-return/config/state boundary is recorded as an intentional maintainer decision.
